item.description:
• Reorganized sidebar: added a customizable "Pinned" section (up to 9 favorites)
  • Added Character/Corporation switch to keep your personal navigation separate from corp screens, plus a filter field to quickly jump to any section
  • Drag to reorder in each section: Every sidebar section (Pinned, Pilot, Economy, Combat & Fleet, Social & Comms, Universe, Corporation, Utility) can now be rearranged by dragging items into the order you prefer
